question: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle A=40^\circ\) and \(\angle B=50^\circ\). What type of triangle is \(\triangle ABC\)?
solution: \(\angle A+\angle B=90^\circ\), so \(\angle C=180^\circ-90^\circ=90^\circ\). Thus, \(\triangle ABC\) is a right triangle.
